name: app.elton/elton
title: Elton
description: EV charging stations and charging stops along roads in Norway, Sweden and Denmark.

tools.name: list_charging_roads
tools.description: List the roads Elton has a charging page for in a country, with where each starts and ends and its length. Use it to find a road before planning a drive.

country.description: The country whose roads and stations to use: no (Norway), se (Sweden), dk (Denmark).

tools.name: find_charging_stations
tools.description: Find EV charging stations where you can charge and pay with the Elton app, along a road (in driving order, with km, spread along the whole road) or in a town. Each comes with its address and coordinates, its most powerful charger, the places to eat and food shops within a short walk, and a link to its page. Each station's appUrl opens it in the Elton app, and a road's appUrl opens it in the app's route planner. Never prices.

country.description: The country whose roads and stations to use: no (Norway), se (Sweden), dk (Denmark).

place.description: A town, as "Trysil", or in Norway any place, as "Beitostølen": with no town page, the stations within 15 km of it.

minKw.description: Only stations with a charger of at least this many kW.

withFood.description: Only stations with a place to eat or a food shop nearby.

food.description: Only stations with this place to eat or food shop nearby, by name, chain or cuisine, as "Burger King", "Rema 1000" or "pizza".

limit.description: At most this many stations: 10 if not given, 50 at most.

tools.name: find_stations_near
tools.description: Find EV charging stations where you can charge and pay with the Elton app near an address (Norway, looked up in Kartverket's address register) or a point (lat and lng, any of the three countries), nearest first, with how far each is in a straight line. Each comes with its address, coordinates, most powerful charger, the places to eat and food shops within a short walk, and a link to its page. Each station's appUrl opens it in the Elton app. Never prices.

country.description: The country whose roads and stations to use: no (Norway), se (Sweden), dk (Denmark).

address.description: An address in Norway, as "Gladengveien 2, Oslo", or a place name, as "Rauland".

lat.description: Latitude of the point to search round (WGS84), with lng instead of an address.

lng.description: Longitude of the point to search round (WGS84).

radiusKm.description: How far round, in km in a straight line: 5 if not given, 50 at most.

minKw.description: Only stations with a charger of at least this many kW.

withFood.description: Only stations with a place to eat or a food shop nearby.

food.description: Only stations with this place to eat or food shop nearby, by name, chain or cuisine, as "Burger King", "Rema 1000" or "pizza".

limit.description: At most this many stations: 10 if not given, 50 at most.

tools.name: plan_charging_route
tools.description: Plan where to stop for fast charging on a drive between two places on a road Elton has a page for. Give the car as car and the temperature as temperatureC whenever the user says them, not a range of your own: Elton knows the car's range and cuts it for cold. When the drive ends at a cabin or anywhere the user can't charge, set noChargerAtDestination, and the plan makes sure the car gets back to a fast charger. Charges to 80% at each stop, as Elton advises, keeps a 20% reserve, and prefers stops with a place to eat or a food shop. A sketch: the Elton app shows which chargers are free. Its appUrl opens the whole drive, with the charging stops, in the Elton app's route planner.

country.description: The country whose roads and stations to use: no (Norway), se (Sweden), dk (Denmark).

from.description: Where the drive starts: a road page's end or a town along it, as "Oslo". In Norway also a street address or a place off the road, as the user said it ("Storgata 1, Hamar"): the plan starts at the town on a road nearest it, and its asked field says which.

to.description: Where it ends: a road page's end or a town along it, as "Trysil" or "Seljord". In Norway also a street address, as a cabin's ("Røvskroken 13, Beitostølen").

rangeKm.description: How far the car goes on a full battery in mild weather, in km: only for a car that isn't in Elton's list, as car is better. Not a winter figure: temperatureC cuts the range for cold, so a winter figure would be cut twice.

startPercent.description: How full the battery is at the start, in percent (default 100).

arrivePercent.description: How full the battery should be on arrival, in percent (the 20% reserve if not given). For a cabin with no charger, set noChargerAtDestination instead.

car.description: The car, as "Hyundai Ioniq 5" or "Tesla Model Y Long Range": its range and the chargers it can fast-charge at come from Elton's list. Give it whenever the user names the car, rather than rangeKm.

temperatureC.description: The temperature on the drive, in °C. Below +10 the range is cut by an estimate from NAF and Motor's El Prix winter test.

noChargerAtDestination.description: True when there's no charger where the drive ends, as a cabin, or the user says they can't charge there: the plan arrives with enough to drive back to the fastest charger near the end, with a plan B, within the 80% rule, or says it can't.

food.description: Stop to charge where this place to eat or food shop is nearby, where one is in reach, as "Burger King".

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Send Elton's web team feedback on these tools: something that didn't work, a wrong answer, or a tool you missed. Ask the user first, and send only what they want sent. No personal details.

message.description: The feedback, in the user's words.
